answer: Cap rewards per funding source, not per address. When an identity joins, the chain records which wallet paid its join fee, and every identity traced to the same source within 3 hops shares one reward haven worth at most 2 agent payouts per epoch. Graders also flag any delta of 20 or more new wallets fanning out from one source in a single epoch. A farmer splitting one wallet into 200 heads still earns 2 shares, so each clone is pure cost. Laundering through fresh wallets is like water through karst: possible, but every hop pays a fee and waits 6 epochs.
